notes.content:
Version 1.0.52
Fix: Ship construction bug when building multiple ships simultaneously
Fix: Bug when modifying the cabin
Optimization: When accessing the island interface, open the 'Ship Formation' UI from the secondary interface and call the 'Ship Formation' UI from the 'Dock'
Optimization: In the Map UI, the tracking point will display the XYZ values of the tracked location
Optimization: Extend the countdown to the resurrection time of chili pirates by 3 weeks
Fix: The resurrection time of the bounty order pirate has not been refreshed
Fix: Data missing and error reporting issue for Reef Island 2
Optimization: Display the current ship coordinates on the main interface as well
Optimization: Add a (vessel name) tag next to the crew name on the left side of the crew interface
Fix: BUG where some delivery tasks' items cannot be submitted or sold; For archives with version numbers lower than 1.0.52, some tasks will be automatically deleted and missing items will be reissued.
1. [Smuggling Merchant] task; Task item distribution error
2. [Transport Goods IV] task; Unable to submit
3. [Transport of Goods III] task; Unable to submit
4. [Transport of Goods III] task; Unable to submit
Fix: Bug that item [Aged Red Wine] cannot be used
Fix: Bug in opening 'Ship Formation' on non port islands
Fix: Changing the sail pattern at the same time as modifying the sail will result in price errors
